news.title: M&MFIN: Dividend Timeline And Tweaked Assumptions Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services by about ₹12.55 to ₹348, reflecting updated assumptions for fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E multiples. What's in the News Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services declared an annual dividend of ₹7.50 per share, with payment scheduled for August 20, 2026, and an ex date and record date of July 13, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹7.50
news.body: Dividend of ₹7.50 is 15% higher than last year. Ex-date: 13th July 2026 Payment date: 20th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 2.5%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.7%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (33% earnings payout ratio) but the company has no free cash flows available, indicating it may be using cash reserves or debt to pay the dividend. The dividend has increased by an average of 5.0% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 50% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹20.88 (up from ₹18.32 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹121.5b (up 51% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹28.5b (up 26% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 24% (down from 28% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 2.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 4.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 7% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 4% per year.

news.title: M&MFIN: Undervalued Case Will Rely On Upcoming Board And RSU Decisions
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services to about ₹370 from roughly ₹376, citing slightly revised assumptions for fair value, discount rate and forward P/E, while keeping revenue growth and profit margin expectations largely in line with earlier estimates. What's in the News Shareholders are scheduled to vote via postal ballot on 7 February 2026 on appointing Ms. Padmaja Chunduru as an Independent Director for a five year term from 10 November 2025 to 9 November 2030, not liable to retire by rotation (company filing).

news.title: M&MFIN: Undervalued Outlook Will Hinge On Upcoming Board And Governance Decisions
news.body: Analysts have inched their consolidated price target for Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services slightly lower from ₹377.00 to about ₹376.47, reflecting updated assumptions around discount rate, profit margin and forward P/E multiples, while keeping revenue growth expectations broadly aligned with earlier views. What's in the News The board has scheduled a meeting for Jan 28, 2026 at 14:00 IST to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, subject to limited review by joint statutory auditors, and to consider other matters (company filing).

news.title: M&MFIN: Stable Outlook Will Rely On Upcoming Board And Governance Decisions
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services steady at ₹377.00, with only minor tweaks to assumptions such as the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E helping to refine, rather than materially shift, their overall price target view. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for Jan 28, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended Dec 31, 2025, along with other matters (company filing).

news.title: M&MFIN: Board Changes And New Equity Plan Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have slightly raised their price target for Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services from ₹375.36 to ₹377.00. They cite updated fair value analysis that incorporates marginal adjustments to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions.

news.title: M&MFIN: Governance Appointments And New Equity Plan Will Shape A Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target for Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services from ₹342.50 to about ₹375.36, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins, the discount rate, and future P/E expectations. What's in the News A special shareholders meeting is scheduled via postal ballot on Feb 7, 2026, to vote on appointing Ms. Padmaja Chunduru as an Independent Director for a five-year term from Nov 10, 2025, to Nov 9, 2030, not liable to retire by rotation (company filing).

news.title: Price target increased by 7.7% to ₹369
news.body: Up from ₹343, the current price target is an average from 33 analysts. New target price is approximately in line with last closing price of ₹374. Stock is up 35% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹20.41 for next year compared to ₹18.32 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.93 (vs ₹7.43 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.93 (down from ₹7.43 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹27.5b (up 8.8% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.24b (down 10% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 30% (down from 36% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 6% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 16% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
